hook: Where You Go, I Will Go
text: On a dusty road out of Moab, a grieving widow told her daughter-in-law to go back home. But Ruth would not leave her. This is what she said. Ruth said, Don't urge me to leave you, and to return from following you, for where you go, I will go; and where you stay, I will stay. Your people will be my people, and your God my God. Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May the Lord do so to me, and more also, if anything but death parts you and me.
title: Where You Go, I Will Go (Ruth 1)
